job: Show why a control is off and who can turn it on.
purpose: A control with a visible line beside or under it giving the reason and who can change it, linked with aria-describedby. Works for buttons, switches and links made into buttons. Use aria-disabled="true" to keep the control focusable. A whole group goes in a fieldset with disabled and a legend; its Fire controls look disabled.
useWhen: A permission, plan or state turns a control off and the person needs to know what to do.
Keyboard users must hear the reason where they meet the control.

avoidWhen.when: The reason only needs a hint on hover.
A field is not editable but readable.

states.name: disabled
states.how: disabled, or aria-disabled="true" to stay focusable

variants.useWhen: The reason sits beside the control.

parts.role: The wrapper around the control and its reason.
The reason line; its id is the control's aria-describedby.
Who can change it, by name or role.

keyboard.does: Reaches an aria-disabled control and reads its reason.
